batch_order: P2_CONDITIONAL_COVERAGE if prescribed by anchor outcomes
freeze_scope: all points in selected batch; independent Phase A/B per batch
sources: up to 9 same-n confidence-feasible B0_saved complete vectors
complete vectors of 3 certified B2 single-resource minimum solve candidates
dedup: exact rational complete tuple; keep all source IDs
uncertified_minimum: Case C -> TECHNICAL_INCONCLUSIVE_BUDGET_GENERATION or existing specific technical failure; STOP; no rescue/retry
canonical_identity: SHA256 of sorted compact JSON + newline; exact resource Fraction strings
write_policy: exclusive create; both freeze and SHA receipt saved before any B3 in batch
Phase_B: hash/input/status/count/derived-query checks; process only BUDGET_READY points, persist skipped-point descriptors without B3 calls; recheck hash after batch
feedback: no budget/grid/settings additions or deletions; P2 context selection only through fixed anchor gate
minimum_resource_type: complete vector for certified feasible; null for certified infeasible
certified_infeasible_minimum: exact rational Farkas proof from maximum one auxiliary; reverify the returned ray against that minimum LP

certified_infeasible_point.condition: one or more certified infeasible objective

technical_point: no completed batch freeze; full returned vectors/last task in certificates and technical_failure.json/result.json
